# awscreen

> See this machine — what is on screen, and where to click it.

Automating a desktop means naming things that have no names. Coordinates rot on the next resize, selectors do not exist outside a browser, and the one thing that does not change is what a human would see and point at.

## Install

```
pip install awscreen
```

## In Claude Code

- skill: `/awscreen`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Find the thing you want to click by describing what it looks like.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awvision](https://aitherium.github.io/awvision/) — See an image — describe it, ask it a question, compare two.
- [awbrowse](https://aitherium.github.io/awbrowse/) — A portable browser client — navigate, console, network, DOM, screenshot.
